title: Complete H25 automatic-retention source contract
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Complete the original H25 automatic-retention issuer and hook **source contract**. A distinct GPT-6.1-sol Max whole-source review accepts the complete original R01–R11 conjunction for the exact v2 subject, SHA256 `5c006e6eccb4bb7605e75ce96fc6370d6e4a9d45a7e43068c174208259b662bb`: 46 source pins, seven profiles and 17 control pins. The connected guardian/C2/fork-only borrower/issuer/writer-seal/archive/oracle/readback/release source and its evidence are inspectable in one new directory, `research/h25-s03-retention-completion-source/`.

The automatic-retention implementation satisfies the accepted source contract. The separate source-adoption result was already delivered in [PR #6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715) and is not claimed again here. Source acceptance is distinct from full original execution, installed-native/current-kernel/grant qualification, resource fit, funding/settlement, scientific performance and κ. Those later gates remain open.

The exact whole-source decision completed at 2026-11-05T12:24:44.459671Z, **29.459671 seconds after** the fixed 12:24:15 review checkpoint. This is disclosed without backdating or on-time gate credit. The user's continuous completion authority remained separate from that phase checkpoint.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6732](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6732).

Direct user assignment: complete the automatic-retention source contract, obtain independent verification and publish the scoped result upstream. Scope is unchanged: complete the original source conjunction. The inert archive format is a publication refinement that preserves absolute source locators and explicit acquisition limits instead of inventing a portable production loader or runtime grant. No task picker was run.

Canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, tree `e6898c8ba7a27b71587c32ba3f639259ceeeed91`. The prepublication refresh at 12:21:55 UTC retained that base and the seven implicated heads; its bounded recent all-author PR delta returned zero, without a novelty claim. `UPSTREAM-PINS.json` preserves the exact query and observed scope.

Preserve [#6317](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6317) archive/oracle `336015471e4f1bb95998f293aa76823fe11e33d5`; [#6339](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6339) cleanup/primary `608ad23adc6c01264c8195daf7f18e29c17464a7`; [#6346](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6346) `abff67b31fa781e950c82d95eccb6f168950943c`; [#6588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6588) preparation `ff7df8391c3bb3f5518ce43682ba4c1e41380e3e`; [#6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715) source adoption `dc34598c22e2ef43ae7e11fc1d8c14de3915cf89`; and [#6732](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6732) finite native-source subject `dd058d2990d3a98692553018387ec19eaf474b42`. [#6709](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6709), `24417a34746985dd110d70a42b2b863b96963c12`, retains its separate financial-meter scope; metadata-only G is incompatible with qualifying the present construction. Concrete reuse/adaptation reasons and predecessor failures remain in the source/review records.

The closed failed predecessor assessment, correction, close record and superseded v1 manifest are retained. The successor repairs authenticated C2 projection, enclosing resource limits, actual capture mode and raw caught-error custody, together with later finite findings; the complete accepted conjunction supplies credit, rather than a helper or PR.

## Validation

The parent completed 17 guarded command attempts in the declared scope; actual argv, environment, limits, receipts, stdout/stderr and timing are included separately from source review:

- Current R08 retention source under declared fake ports: **39 controls in normal and 39 in optimized mode**, independently accepted for the exact current error/native-I/O helpers.
- Python boundaries in each mode: **34 entry + 4 constructor + 8 resource + 21 connected = 67**. The first three use actual whole source modules with inert ports. The 21 connected checks use explicit AST-extracted pure definitions and earn that narrower scope.
- Actual native compilation and ordinary-file C fixture execution: syntax check and two builds succeeded; predecessor **17 checks / four expected actual failures / exit 1**; repaired **23 checks / zero failures / exit 0**. Guardian main was renamed and never called. This exercised bounded file/fstat/chmod/read/fsync/known-close boundaries and literal address-space helpers, not the installed guardian/current-kernel/cgroup/grant/native workload. Compiler diagnostics are retained.
- Earlier B124 **31 controls per mode** remain historical evidence and explicitly do not qualify the current helpers.

The whole-source assessment binds those exact results and all 70 current source/profile/control pins. AI source/result review is distinct from human or proof-kernel verification. No complete original caller/science/archive run or full original C01–C17 union is claimed. The retained pre-adjudication validation summary still contains its historical pending/zero-credit fields; the final whole review, canonical adoption records and `ACCEPTANCE-STATUS.json` explicitly supersede them.

Executable source is inert `.py.txt`/`.c.txt`/`.h.txt`; JSON profiles remain exact metadata. Original `0444` source mode is recorded separately from archival Git `100644`. The three small external H source bodies and selected source-adoption manifest are supplied with exact origin/byte/hash mapping. Prior public leaf URLs remain null where unestablished. Inherited proof/design references are pinned as metadata; the huge predecessor archive and protected runtime histories are not duplicated or decoded.

`python3 -I -S -B INTEGRITY.py` checks archival ordinary-file inventory and bytes only, importing no archived source. No executable `VERIFY.json` hook or portable runtime replay is registered. `MANIFEST.json` excludes itself; the external publication allowlist binds it and the raw Git blob identities. Hosted checks will be read for the actual submitted head, with pending/failed/skipped states reported as observed; skipped replay earns no candidate execution credit.

Ledger 034 records **670.890533479/2400 seconds**, including 285 new policy seconds for the declared 17 attempts. Complete physical/outside-operation/preparation/review/metadata/publication/final-tail costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`. No new budget, goal-service resume, automation or merge authority is created.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight; original H25 source/archive/independent-oracle/review owners; predecessor and parallel authors, including unpaidmoon/Cursor Grok for #6339 and the #6321/#6029 lineage; and original third-party authors. Substantial ChatGPT Pro/OpenAI Codex assistance, with distinct GPT-6.1-sol Max source/result review. New material is Apache-2.0; copied notices and external source-specific rights remain intact. Referenced GNU time/gnulib/GNU libc/CPython sources are not relicensed by this archive.

## Open next questions

The package README names the next genuine runtime gates. First compare one intended installed executable/library/loader/current-kernel/delegation tuple with the accepted source/profile requirements, identify the first missing authentic input, and obtain its independent qualification before any target operation. This matters because source semantics do not issue current ownership or a one-use grant. Full concurrent resource fit, original-control/caller/archive execution, funding and settlement remain separately blocked by their genuine authority/evidence requirements. No further helper is needed to re-complete the accepted automatic-retention source contract, and this delivery starts no new scientific round.
